gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-albert-sans: Albert Sans reads as a plain sans with lines that keep their thickness in every direction and apertures that stay open even when tiny. Comic Relief up top brings the loud, bowls-left-unfinished personality, and the two split the work easily.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-alef: Comic Relief shows off bold, commanding letters whose up and side strokes look the same, with bowls left unfinished on one side. Alef is the sans-serif that does the quiet job better, with open-ended curves running clean through the text.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-alegreya-sans-sc: Loud and slightly lopsided up top. Alegreya Sans SC, a sans-serif with a welcoming gap in the c, sits beneath it and lets the heading's open-bowled swagger carry the attention.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-almarai: Almarai reads as a sans-serif with a line width that never swells or tapers, and letters that never pinch shut. Comic Relief is the one for bold shouting; Almarai is for steady talking.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-amarna: Commanding is how Comic Relief lands, with bowls left unfinished on one side and no change between up and side strokes. Amarna, a sans-serif with contrast-free strokes and small counters that never clog, feels tidy and contemporary beside it.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-andika: Bold, with bowls left open on one side, Comic Relief takes the top spot. Andika, a sans-serif with tails as thick as its stems and wide, easy s turns, would carry a long passage in a friendly, modern way.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-anta: Comic Relief is loud, unfinished and bowl-happy. Anta is a sans with gaping e mouths and a wire-bent sign look at constant thickness, so a longer passage would feel approachable and crisp rather than heavy.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-antic: Bowls left unfinished on one side, and no difference between up and side strokes: that is Comic Relief. Antic, a plain sans drawn with one nib, with open mouths like unjoined chalk arcs, does the steady reading work.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-ar-one-sans: AR One Sans reads as a sans-serif that lifts its brush ends away before each curve closes, giving it a modern look. AR One Sans over a longer passage would feel light and flowing beneath Comic Relief's stitched-thread heading.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-assistant: Thin plastic tubing, bent into loops. Comic Relief carries that bold look, while Assistant, a sans-serif with mouths staying open on c, e, and a, is the contemporary and approachable partner below it.
